steps.content:
23:37, July 21, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
The Blue Rain is falling across the whole city. Duration: 30 hours.
When the maid arrived, Rahu was looking out the windows, watching the blue rain pattering outside the villa.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Where is Miss Shalom?

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Still sleeping. Miss Shalom is recovering very slowly, so she can't stay awake for too long every day.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Miss Rahu, I'm here to tell you that your room has been cleaned and is ready for you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'll go after finishing the risk assessment.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This villa needs to be searched thoroughly. I will check every corner. Do I need a permit?

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: No, you have free access to every corner of this house. Here are the keys to all the rooms. Or do you prefer... that I go with you?
The maid hesitated for a moment before finally gathering the courage to speak.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: ...Actually, it's just something I want to tell you.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Miss Shalom is a gentle person, and the best boss I've ever had. She's friendlier than all the other Eastside elites. If this hadn't happened, I would've never guessed that she's from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: She's getting such cruel treatment simply because she's from Paradeisos. She's such a gentle person and has clearly done nothing wrong, yet no one can take her away...

steps.speaker: Maid
steps.content: Miss Rahu, you'll protect her, won't you?
Rahu looks at the maid's concerned face, then shifts her gaze to the Blue Rain outside the window.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...The Blue Rain suppresses anything Mania-related, whether they are Sinners or Corruptors.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: It's unlikely that the enemy will launch any large-scale attacks in the next few days. A couple of routine checks will do. No need to be as tense as the past few days.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Go and get some rest. Y'all must be tired. Leave the rest to me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Your boss will be fine.
The maid smiles somewhat bashfully, curtsies to Rahu and leaves.
After the maid left, the villa is all quiet. Rahu walks down the empty corridor, opening the doors one by one with the keys she got and carefully searching each room.

There are no hidden rooms or secret triggers, and all the surveillance cameras are temporary installations. This is an ordinary Eastside luxury villa. The bland and unlabeled food products in the kitchen don't seem to be from Eastside. There aren't many clothes, only a few pieces that are much plainer than what the other upper-class women wear around here.

The lady of the house leads a life quite different from that of both Eastside elites and West District residents. This is in line with some of the vague stereotypes about Paradeisos. But that's all there is to it.
There are no papers or personal items that reveal her background, occupation, relationships, or any other information.
Rahu checks every room before finally coming to the study. She finds an old-fashioned photo album among the annoying flowers and opens it hopefully.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Tsk.

Aside from the flowers, there are portraits of people from all walks of life—nearby residents, reporters, councilors, doctors, guards, vendors, tailors, and unknown children. But the photos were obviously all taken in the villa, and they are all of ordinary Eastsiders.
None of the photos were taken in Paradeisos or show any distinguished Paradeisos guests.
After the attack, the doctors and guards who came were all Eastsiders. Even some councilors came to kiss up. However, there hasn't been any contact from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Ms. Shalom has been here for less than a year and has kept a low profile. We didn't know that she was from Paradeisos until she was attacked for the first time three days ago...

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: In the beginning, our superiors took the initiative to contact us, mentioning that Paradeisos was aware of our situation. They instructed us to protect the VIP and regularly update the safety data, assuring us that support would arrive soon.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: But since then, there's been no word from them. It's just been us, sending data, always sending more data... We want to reach out to Paradeisos, but who even knows where or who they are?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: I know, our efforts barely amount to actual protection. But I don't even understand the current situation; I constantly feel like someone's watching us...

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Even if things are hard to organize in Syndicate, it's clear that other members of Paradeisos are all under heightened protection. I just don't get it!
Rahu is a bit frustrated. It took her so much effort to get close to this woman, yet she can't peek at Paradeisos through her. It's always been like that.
It doesn't matter if she gets more power or reaches a more important position. As long as she is a part of FAC, she still can't reach any truth outside the battlefield.
As if the giant curtain of the world has descended in front of her, she is unable to reach beyond it. She remains trapped in a past that she cannot change.
A scene slowly comes to her mind. A cemetery shrouded in rain and fog, sparse flowers in front of the headstone, remembering those who will never return...
Is it because of the Blue Rain? Rahu starts to remember more irrelevant things. It feels almost suffocating. She lets go of the mask and tries to ease her breath, attempting to calm herself down.
Sergeant Rahu?
Leaning against the door frame and draped in a thin blanket, the Paradeisos woman gazes at Rahu.
Rahu looks back at her. She closes the photo album in her hands and puts it back on the shelf. Shalom just gazes at her without saying a word.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Why did you wake up at this hour? If you feel unwell, I'll call the doctor or the maid.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'm fine. I slept for a long time and dreamt of rain. When I opened my eyes again, it was quite late.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What about you? Are you staying up all night to stand guard?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's my job.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You should get some rest. The Blue Rain also affects Sinners.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Judging from the way you look, you haven't slept well for a long time. You must be feeling tired, no? Don't force yourself.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No need to worry. The most important thing is your safety. Let me take you back to your room to rest.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...You look really stressed. Can I help you with anything?
The Blue Rain is irritating enough as it is, and now she has to chat with this Paradeisos woman, too. Rahu's patience is wearing thin, and she has to actively control her emotions.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: When are you planning to go back to Paradeisos?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Why do you ask that?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You are in grave danger right now. They should take you back. The sheriffs' capabilities are totally not up to par for someone from Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Do you have a reason for insisting on staying here?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Or... is it because you can't go back?
The woman doesn't avert Rahu's gaze, and slowly flashes a sincere smile.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Did you hear any interesting rumors about me? For example, that I'm a "disgraced and exiled Paradeisos noblewoman"?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Those are just people's speculations about Paradeisos. It doesn't correspond to reality. I have my reasons for staying here...
Rahu remained silent for a while before speaking up.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let's cut to the chase.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Your life is in grave danger, but the security force assigned to protect you is abysmal, and no one has come to escort you to safety. You've been cast here like a piece of meat thrown to a pack of wolves. It makes no sense.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let me just ask you straight up. Did Paradeisos <color=#fb9259>abandon</color> you, or you their <color=#fb9259>bait</color>?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Are they sacrificing you just to catch the culprit of these attacks?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...If that's the case, will you give up your mission, Sergeant Rahu?
Rahu is taken aback by her question.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I will keep you safe until the danger is gone.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is it out of sympathy?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm an FAC soldier. Protecting you is my job. My work doesn't require sympathy.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Then who assigned you this mission? It wouldn't make any sense to protect bait. So why are you here?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...The sheriffs here pleaded for help again and again. They were kept in the dark and caught up in this crisis.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Those around you are innocent, and... so are you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The FAC can't just let all of you die like this.
Shalom looks at her for a long time before speaking again.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I see. Thank you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The original plan will remain unchanged, but since you're here, I hope you'll protect me and catch the culprit at the same time. Also...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I hope you don't get hurt from this dangerous mission.
After a brief silence, Rahu lowered her eyelids and put on her mask.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let me walk you back to your room to rest.
At last, she is the only one left. The sound of rain tap against the windows, casting shadows within. Rahu walks down the long corridor, heading towards the main door.
No power, no background, a frail body, and not even a family member to seek help from... That's why Paradeisos "chose" her. No one will care if she dies.
Even if I save her and gain her trust, it'll be impossible to get to Paradeisos through her. She can't even go back herself.
That woman is useless...
After a while, muffled cackles ring out from behind her mask.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hehe... but the fish she'll catch seems quite valuable...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The enemy that Paradeisos wants to catch... a bunch of Mania killers... You old foxes, what do you want from her?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: If I catch 'em first, will you guys come to me...? Hehehe...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Just you wait. I'll bring the meat right to your mouths.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: You're... that FAC... wait, where are you going? Don't leave...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Having you here is enough. I'm off to clear the real threat.
It's morning already, but the rain hasn't stopped.
She leaves the villa and rushes to her destination.
